$comment: Percentages require evidence. VERIFIED requires evidence. UNMEASURED carries no number at all. Enforced by scripts/check-progress.mjs.

A real, previously-undetected backend bug was found and fixed while verifying this slice: the local test fixture's match.dimensions failed schema validation, silently breaking every Save action - this was fixed at the data layer, not by loosening the schema

CS-13: shared LoadingState/ErrorState/EmptyState components exist and are used by the shell and the Jobs route; not yet rolled out inside Saved/Resume/Settings/Preparation/Career Resources' own internals
CS-14: the Leads screen now exposes all 6 real backend statuses (previously 2 of 6) and has a verified zero-overflow mobile layout at 320/768/1440px

CS-50: a real /applications route now exists (previously did not), reusing the reviewed SavedLeads component via a scope prop rather than a separate fabricated ATS UI - 4 real application statuses (applied/interviewing/offer/rejected), zero new schema or fake fields

The Saved/Applications lead-detail view was rebuilt end-to-end against a specialist-produced design spec (header, 3-col Job Details/Timeline/Actions grid, real match evidence, Documents+Notes, honest "AI Insights - not available yet"); every field is real data, no fabricated stage, score or document

A real CSS overflow regression introduced by that rebuild (27px horizontal scroll at 320px) was root-caused via live element-by-element bisection (not guessed) to a flex-shrink:0 header-actions block colliding with its own wrapped button row, and fixed; re-verified at 320/768/1440px with scrollWidth===clientWidth
v2/apps/web builds, typechecks, lints and formats clean across every file touched this round
Resume, Settings, Preparation and Career Resources routes are functionally real but still carry the pre-redesign plain CSS - no visual pass yet

UPDATE 2026-09-25: the disclosed check-ui.ts regression is RESOLVED - the suite is repaired, hardened and green on all three engines. Separately, CS-51 fixed a family of five defects where an identifier present at the call site was discarded before reaching its destination (Open Saved Lead opened the list but not the lead; clicking any Recent Discovery run opened the newest one). Four fixed, the fifth (SaveJob not hydrating already-saved state) blocked on a missing backend job-to-lead lookup and documented rather than faked.

CS-13 remains the clearest open frontend gap and its status was corrected from UAT to IN PROGRESS on 2026-09-24: the shared loading/empty/error components are imported by exactly TWO modules while the (app) route group has EIGHT routes.
Root suite 1055/1055 and v2 unit 49/49 passing locally (re-measured 2026-09-25, not carried forward).

v2 test:integration 42/42 exit 0 on a quiet database. It now runs in CI with real PostgreSQL, Redis and LocalStack service containers - the gap this area previously recorded as "six v2 integration files need Postgres and Redis and run nowhere (CS-9)" is closed.

CS-33 and CS-35 were independently confirmed genuinely implemented at source level. CS-33 is now UAT; CS-35 returned REVISE because its AC2 is not implemented - the server emits typed conflict codes correctly but the client ApiError type carries no code field, so the contract terminates at the network boundary.
Open and ticketed: CS-53 composite FKs, CS-55 unrate-limited authenticated GETs, CS-56 title character allowlist, CS-57 logout non-null assertion.
13 tables and 15 applied migrations, with 18 CHECK constraints, 10 indexes and 2 composite foreign keys — the schema is substantially complete, not a sketch

Security review found search_jobs and run_events reference searches.id and users.id separately rather than a composite (owner_id, run_id) key, so a cross-owner row is representable at the database layer
v2/scripts/check-database-recovery.ts exists but no recovery run has been recorded, and no scheduled dump exists (CS-25)
Postings have no retention or liveness recheck (CS-27), and identity can merge two real openings (CS-28)
Deployed and serving: careerscope.tech/api/health returns 3.0.0
Deploy now refuses a commit CI rejected (CS-7), unverified in a live run

THE NUMBER WENT DOWN from 72 on 2026-09-25, and no security control was weakened to cause that. Progress here is verified scope over REQUIRED scope, and a forensic security census enlarged the required scope by finding five previously untracked issues. The code did not get worse; what is known about it got more complete. Recording a drop is the honest result and this project instruction is explicit that the number must be able to fall.

VERIFIED CLEAN and not to be re-litigated - an independent read of all 34 route handlers confirmed: no route reads an owner identifier from the client (request.ownerId is assigned in exactly one place, the onRequest hook, from a server-side session lookup); all SQL parameterized in every file read; cookie flags correct (httpOnly, sameSite strict, path /api, secure derived from origin scheme rather than hardcoded); logging never records URLs or bodies and redact covers cookie/authorization/password/token; origin check is exact equality; Argon2id m=19456 t=2 p=1 not weakened; session fixation defence plus a FOR UPDATE re-read of the password hash inside the login transaction.
CRITICAL findings: NONE FOUND - stated as "none found", not "none exist", because the reviewer had no shell and no network and its conclusions are source-level.

NEW AND NOW TICKETED: CS-54 web CSP script-src unsafe-inline (VERIFIED by the Orchestrator at v2/apps/web/next.config.ts:27; the API-side CSP is strict and is a separate surface); CS-53 search_jobs/run_events use separate rather than composite FKs so a cross-owner row is representable at the database layer, defence-in-depth only with no reachable exploit; CS-55 eleven authenticated GET routes unrated-limited including the most expensive read, which the UI itself polls every 5-10s; CS-56 derived.titles length-bounded but not character-constrained, reaching stored match evidence verbatim - not exploitable under today only renderer (auto-escaping JSX) but a surface any future non-React renderer inherits silently; CS-57 a non-null assertion on the session cookie in POST /api/logout.

THE LARGEST SECURITY-ADJACENT GAP IS COVERAGE, NOT CODE (CS-52): ai-provider.test.ts carries the API-key-never-logged assertions, the 256 KiB bounded-read proof, the model-catalog fail-closed cases and the structural test asserting matching never imports AI - and it ran in NO pipeline. check-ui.ts, the only cross-engine E2E, exercises the auth boundary and ran nowhere either. Both are now wired; neither is CI-executed.
Live /api/health measured 2026-09-19 from this machine: 196ms, 105ms, 91ms — the deployed origin responds, but this is one endpoint over the public internet, not a workload
v2/scripts/check-performance.ts exists and measures p95, concurrency, duration and request counts, so the capability is present
No performance result has ever been recorded in the progress evidence, and the check runs in no pipeline
Public payload measured: jobs.json is 0.54 MB across 2,529 rows and parses in 9ms; the rebuilt page ships 50 KB with the first 20 rows inlined
Nothing has been measured for the database, the queue, the workers or the browser, which is where this application would actually degrade

Root suite 1055/1055 (67 files) and v2 unit 49/49 pass locally, both re-run by the Orchestrator on 2026-09-25. The v2 unit count rose 37 -> 49 because ai-provider.test.ts was wired into test:unit; the 12 new cases are the OpenRouter matrix that previously ran nowhere.

RESOLVED 2026-09-24/25: the regression this area previously recorded - "v2/scripts/check-ui.ts is stale against the CS-6 routing change and would fail as-is" - is fixed. The suite runs green end-to-end on chromium, firefox and webkit, now enforces WCAG 2.2 AA (it had been pinned to 2.1 while its criterion said 2.2, with zero new violations once corrected), and is wired into ci.yml for the first time.

WIRED IS NOT CI-EXECUTED, and the distinction is the point: neither check-ui.ts nor ai-provider.test.ts has yet run in a real pipeline. Commit authorisation is the unlock. Do not read a green local run as enforcement.

THE NUMBER ONLY ROSE 3 POINTS DESPITE REAL WORK, DELIBERATELY. Four separate checks-that-cannot-fail were found in one night: the skip-link contract that would have stayed green with tabIndex={-1} removed; the nav assertion collecting [] from a selector deleted by CS-6; CS-47 curl stub that discards the POST body so json_escape() is exercised by no test; and CS-48 data-minimization test asserting the absence of strings that were never in its input. Two more are historical - R3 --allow-net (a Deno flag Node lacks, unconditionally true) and CS28-1 invisible test file. Finding them means prior confidence in this area was overstated, so wiring gains are partly offset by knowing the coverage was thinner than recorded.

ELEVEN executable checks still run in no pipeline (CS-52), four of which cover exactly the failure modes an audit had to mark NOT VERIFIED: crash recovery, database recovery, queue runtime, soak. The deploy gate runs no V2 tests at all.

Two unexplained intermittent failures now have a ticket and an owner for the first time (CS-58): a WebKit click-stability timeout in check-ui.ts, and an integration failure that survived a demonstrably quiet database with the failing test identity uncaptured.
